Project license policy and historical releases
----------------------------------------------
GIFA is offered under GPL-3.0-only, and future releases will follow this
same license policy. On 2026-11-16, FinalLawer also grants GPL-3.0-only
permission for the GIFA code and original resources that FinalLawer owns
in these existing releases, including their published application files:

v0.2.4: b65a27063e2652424ddf7be732fc66ec1f7b3f22
Source: https://github.com/FinalLawer/GIFA/tree/b65a27063e2652424ddf7be732fc66ec1f7b3f22
v0.2.5: bc89ba0dfb5d41531bafc9e9606a7d6196205909
Source: https://github.com/FinalLawer/GIFA/tree/bc89ba0dfb5d41531bafc9e9606a7d6196205909

This grants a GPLv3 licensing option for those historical versions; it
does not revoke previously granted MIT permissions. Recipients of code
previously released under MIT may still choose that original license.
MIT notices embedded in the original release files record their first
publication and do not prevent this additional GPLv3 grant.

The original MIT notice is preserved in LICENSES/MIT-legacy.txt in the
source repository and resources/licenses/LICENSE-MIT-LEGACY-GIFA.txt
in application distributions as a historical record. It does not grant MIT permission
for later GPL-only changes. This policy does not relicense third-party
components or unrelated projects from the repository's earlier history.

Third-party components
-----------------------
Third-party components retain their own copyright and license terms.
Electron and uiohook-napi's binding are distributed under MIT. The
libUIOHook library linked into uiohook-napi is LGPL-3.0-or-later;
its copyright, full license and corresponding source information are
supplied as libuiohook-NOTICE.txt and LGPL-3.0.txt. Chromium and other
bundled components carry their own notices. See resources/licenses/ for
LICENSE.electron.txt, LICENSES.chromium.html and these library notices;
MIT dependency notices also remain with the modules in app.asar or
app.asar.unpacked. These component licenses do not replace GIFA's
GPL-3.0-only license.

中文说明（便于阅读，具体权利义务以随附的 GPLv3 正文为准）
--------------------------------------------------------
1. 当前项目采用 GNU GPL 第 3 版，仅第 3 版（GPL-3.0-only）。允许商用和
   收费分发；分发程序或修改版本时，应遵守 GPLv3 的许可和对应源码提供要求。
   程序不提供任何担保，法律另有规定的除外。
2. 项目当前及后续版本统一采用 GPL-3.0-only。版权方也为其持有版权的
   v0.2.4、v0.2.5 历史版本及已发布程序新增提供同一 GPLv3 授权，源码提交
   见上文；不覆盖第三方组件或仓库更早的其他项目。
3. 历史版本新增 GPLv3 授权不撤回既有 MIT 权利；已按 MIT 发布的代码仍可
   选择原 MIT 许可。旧附件内的 MIT 声明是首次发布记录，不影响新增 GPLv3 授权。
4. 本项目是非官方的个人辅助工具，与米哈游、哔哩哔哩无任何关联；
   不含游戏客户端文件、不修改游戏内存、不注入游戏进程。
5. 功能所需的管理员权限用于全局热键（Windows UIPI 机制）。
6. 绿色版的数据保存在程序目录 data\，安装版保存在
   %APPDATA%\原神跟跑助手\；卸载安装版默认保留设置与标定。
